edges.reason: _transfer delegates the accounting to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer delegates to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam for the team fee.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee.
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth during user transfers when swapEnabled.
_transfer pushes ETH to fee wallets inside the transfer flow.
_transfer reads balanceOf(address(this)) before swapping.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth on the full contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the whole ETH balance.
transfer calls _transfer.
transferFrom calls _transfer.
transferFrom decreases the allowance via _approve.
approve writes the allowance via _approve.
balanceOf converts reflections with tokenFromReflection.
_getValues uses the current rate from _getRate.
_getValues calls _getTValues.
_getValues calls _getRValues.
_getRate reads supplies from _getCurrentSupply.
swapTokensForEth approves the router for the token amount.
openTrading approves the router for the total supply.
msg.sender becomes the from address in transfer/transferFrom driven transfers.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender.
approve uses _msgSender() as the owner.
manualswap privileges depend on the caller address being _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend privileges depend on the caller address being _feeAddrWallet1.
msg.sender is compared against _feeAddrWallet1 in the guard.
block.timestamp sets the cooldown deadline that gates future transfers.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
Transfer amounts feed the unchecked-style reflection balance arithmetic.
_takeTeam adds the team reflection to _rOwned[address(this)].
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from _rTotal.
setBots writes the owner-controlled blacklist.
delBot clears an entry of the owner-controlled blacklist.
setCooldownEnabled toggles the cooldown access gate.
renounceOwnership clears _owner, removing owner privileges.
swapTokensForEth executes the external router swap call.
sendETHToFee performs external ETH transfers to the fee wallets.
openTrading performs the external addLiquidityETH call with contract ETH.
openTrading calls the factory createPair.
openTrading approves the pair for the maximum amount.
openTrading stores the router address.
openTrading stores the created pair address.
openTrading lowers _maxTxAmount to the trading limit.
openTrading enables auto-swap.
openTrading enables the cooldown gate.
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true.
_transfer reads the inSwap flag to prevent recursive swaps.
_transfer writes the timestamp-based cooldown for the recipient.
_transfer enforces the owner-controlled bot blacklist.
The router swap sends ETH back to this contract, invoking receive() mid-execution.
from parameter drives _transfer account updates.
to parameter drives _transfer account updates.
amount parameter feeds the reflection balance arithmetic.
contractTokenBalance is the amount swapped in swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is the amount forwarded to sendETHToFee.
tokenAmount parameter becomes amountIn of the router swap.
path local is passed to the router swap.
amount parameter is split and transferred to both fee wallets.
sender parameter indexes _rOwned in _transferStandard.
recipient parameter indexes _rOwned in _transferStandard.
tAmount parameter is the input of _getValues.
bots_ array parameter populates the blacklist.
notbot parameter is removed from the blacklist.
onoff parameter toggles cooldownEnabled.
spender parameter is written into _allowances.
currentRate local is produced by _getRate and used in reflection math.
